main.toolTipHeader: Caesura - The break time reminder app
main.mediaKeyPermissionMissing: Caesura needs the accessibility permission to pause a video that plays. Grant it in Preferences → Breaks.
main.warning: This will restore app defaults and all your settings will be lost.

settings.openAtLogin: Start Caesura automatically when logging in
settings.monitorIdleTime: Monitor system idle time (breaks are paused if system is idle).
settings.monitorDnd: Show breaks even in Do Not Disturb mode
settings.poemFullRepeatsInfo: How often the whole poem is shown again after it was read completely, before the next poem follows.

schedule.miniBreaksInfo: Mini breaks are short breaks taken regularly to give you a chance to stretch and relax.
schedule.showNotificationBeforeMiniBreak: Show notification before Mini break starts
schedule.longBreaksInfo: Long breaks are taken less regularly, but are of greater duration, allowing you to take an extended break from your work.
schedule.showNotificationBeforeLongBreak: Show notification before Long break starts
schedule.pauseFullscreenVideoInfo: The video is paused while the break is on the screen and played again when it ends. Works with the frontmost application when Caesura can read its play/pause control over the accessibility interface: in a fullscreen window, or in a video element of a page.
schedule.pauseFullscreenVideoPermission: macOS only lets Caesura read and press the play/pause control of another application with the accessibility permission. The permission belongs to the installed application: a rebuild that changes its signature can ask for it again.
schedule.pauseFullscreenVideoPermissionGranted: Caesura may read and press the play/pause control.
schedule.strictModeInfo: Strict mode prevents you from skipping either Mini breaks or Long breaks and is designed to help discipline.
schedule.enableStrictMini: Enable Strict mode for Mini breaks
schedule.enableStrictLong: Enable Strict mode for Long breaks
schedule.cantDisableBoth: It is not possible to disable both types of breaks

toast.runningBody: Your next break will appear on its own.
